items.summary: Site-factory disposition: maintain a three-candidate scaffold pipeline—complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net—with no domain, spend, deployment, publication, or telemetry changes. The strongest candidate is complicated.work because it is first in the validated site-factory queue and has an existing scaffold, but launch readiness is not verified; analytics is unconfigured, compliance is unknown, and security evidence is incomplete. Exactly one next step: after CTO releases a delivery slot, complete one verified complicated.work readiness artifact covering owner approval, bounded site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics and registered-affiliate readiness, legal/compliance checklist, security evidence, measurement plan, rollback point, and preview-only launch gate. Keep all candidates preview-only until owner, legal, security, measurement, and rollback gates pass.
